review_scope: Independent read-only content review of the 55 objective questions, 11 groups and their reference explanations; database import and release packaging are outside this report.

matching.storage_note: Matching paragraph labels A-M are represented in the group passage; matching questions intentionally have no duplicated option rows.

normalization_notes: PDF extracted group heading appears inside p-22-1; skipped the known group-heading line for this comparison.
Paragraph numbers and print footer are not transcript content.

audio_validation.topic_sample_method: The preexisting local base.en model independently recognized the first 22 seconds at each of the seven published group starts; recognized themes were compared with source group bodies. No new model or remote server was used.

topic_samples.topic: Dividing a presentation between two students
Makeup and perceptions of attractiveness or status
Driver-state sensors and autonomous vehicles in Sweden

checks: All 35 A-D option blocks, 15-word bank and blank numbering 26-35
Separate boundaries for the two reading passages
Listening transcript and answer-analysis source layout samples

normalization_notes: Whitespace was ignored for source comparisons; cloze __(N)__ display was normalized to __N__.
The English listening question stem is moved from the analysis source into the question content field.
Matching and reading Chinese translations are kept before the explanation body, sourced from the same question.
Paragraph counters, drawer controls and position-pill labels are UI elements and are excluded.
Question 31 genuinely has only answer, grammar-slot and evidence sections in the source; all three are retained without inventing rival-word analysis.
Question-PDF blank numbers are extracted separately from paragraph text; physical page 5 was visually checked for all numbers 26-35.
The PDF extraction order inserts the Questions 22 to 25 group heading inside transcript paragraph p-22-1; the known heading line was excluded when comparing that paragraph.

limitations: The source is publisher-provided reference material; official authorship and official reference-answer certification are not established by this review.
Audio checks establish complete decoding, seven topic matches and sensible group starts. They do not certify every spoken word or every listening answer semantically.
PDF and HTML matching demonstrates consistent import from this source, not independent proof that all publisher explanations are flawless.
The structured objective-question scope is 1-55; writing and translation remain available in the full source PDF rather than being treated as automatically graded objective questions.
